wanted_to_measure: Whether a GA can discover CA rules performing a global computation (density classification) and what computational strategies those rules embody.
could_measure: Best-of-generation fitness on random ICs; final rule tables; space-time diagrams; hand computational-mechanics analysis (domains, particles, particle interactions) on a few selected rules; epoch boundaries by fitness jumps.
threw_away: Non-elite genomes per generation (belief); neutral variants of the elite; extinct lineages; per-IC failure records; RNG seeds (unknown); runs that did not reach particle strategies were summarised only as counts (belief).
compute_prevented: Replication beyond a few hundred runs; per-run lineage tracing; systematic forking at epoch boundaries; ablation of individual rule-table bits across many runs; measurement of conditional innovation probability.
anomalies_mentioned_not_pursued: Rarity and seed dependence of the particle-strategy transition; symmetry breaking between rules; dependence on IC density distribution (verify all against text).

questionnaire.ablatable: YES in principle (bit flips), not done at scale

could_measure: Strategy frequency time series; identity of dominant strategies per era; extinction events; memory-length distribution over time.
threw_away: Nothing in the deterministic population dynamics is lost, but low-frequency strategies below a cutoff are removed (belief); mutation event history not retained; only one or few long runs published.
compute_prevented: Many independent long runs; systematic comparison of lineages with and without early duplications.
anomalies_mentioned_not_pursued: Long periods of stasis punctuated by rapid turnover; recurrent coexistence patterns (verify).

wanted_to_measure: Whether a complex logic function (EQU) evolves via simpler rewarded functions, and the role of intermediate steps.
could_measure: Complete line of descent of the focal lineage (every mutation, fitness, tasks); ablation of the rewards for simpler functions; effect of specific mutations by reversion.
threw_away: Non-focal lineages beyond summary; population-level neutral variation (partially retained via Avida's phylogeny tools); behaviour traces of failed lineages.
compute_prevented: Replication beyond ~50 runs per treatment (verify); per-mutation forward replay at scale.
anomalies_mentioned_not_pursued: Deleterious intermediate mutations later required; variability across runs in path to EQU.
